subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Avatar not displaying (broken image)

question: Should Control UI support user-configured remote http(s) agent avatars through a gateway-mediated safe path, or should remote avatars remain unsupported in Control UI despite being accepted by agent identity config?
rationale: The code and docs intentionally block direct remote image fetches for security, but the CLI/config contract still accepts remote avatar values; choosing the fix requires owner intent on the CSP/privacy boundary and user-facing contract.

options.title: Proxy remote avatars safely
options.body: Keep the browser same-origin policy and implement a bounded gateway fetch/proxy or data-URL conversion path with size, MIME, timeout, and privacy constraints so configured remote avatars can render.

options.title: Document unsupported remote avatars
options.body: Keep remote avatars out of Control UI and update CLI/docs/UI metadata so users get an explicit unsupported-state message instead of a broken or silent fallback.

options.title: Allow direct remote images
options.body: Widen Control UI `img-src` and render remote URLs directly, accepting the operator-browser remote fetch and tracking implications.

recommendation.title: Proxy remote avatars safely
recommendation.body: Keep the browser same-origin policy and implement a bounded gateway fetch/proxy or data-URL conversion path with size, MIME, timeout, and privacy constraints so configured remote avatars can render.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history shows `steipete` on the original avatar support, Control UI avatar URL fixes, and recent gateway Control UI serving/security work.
